lines.native: Hello. I’m Marginalia. Esta es la historia de Journathan, el hombre de muchas lenguas. Su viaje a casa dura veinte años. That is from The Journey. I sell books only to people who understand them. No spoilers; just a small reading check. The teeth marks are my review. ¿Adónde va Journathan?
lines.translation: Hello. I’m Marginalia. This is the story of Journathan, the man of many tongues. His journey home lasts twenty years. That is from The Journey. I sell books only to people who understand them. No spoilers; just a small reading check. The teeth marks are my review. Where is Journathan going?
lines.narrative: At The Old Bookshop, a Bookworm looks up from a half-eaten volume. The remaining half is heavily annotated.

lines.native: Un libro es una cosa. ¿Adónde va Journathan? A destination, dear reader, not merchandise. Reading comprehension: not yet shelf-ready. Lee el pasaje otra vez.
lines.translation: A book is a thing. Where is Journathan going? A destination, dear reader, not merchandise. Reading comprehension: not yet shelf-ready. Read the passage again.
lines.narrative: Marginalia writes a small question mark beside your elbow. The margins have begun to spread.

lines.native: La idea es correcta, pero la respuesta está en inglés. Meaning: understood. Spanish: still pending. ¿Adónde va Journathan? En español, por favor. The book has standards. I merely enforce them.
lines.translation: The idea is correct, but the answer is in English. Meaning: understood. Spanish: still pending. Where is Journathan going? In Spanish, please. The book has standards. I merely enforce them.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small annotation beside you. It is not yet a recommendation.

lines.native: ¡Correcto! Va a casa. Reading comprehension: promoted. Now, the first recorded translation trick. No spoilers; the Cyclops had enough problems with perspective. «El Cíclope le pregunta su nombre. Journathan responde: «Mi nombre es Nadie.»» ¿Qué nombre le da Journathan al Cíclope?
lines.translation: Correct! He goes home. Reading comprehension: promoted. Now, the first recorded translation trick. No spoilers; the Cyclops had enough problems with perspective. “The Cyclops asks him his name. Journathan replies: ‘My name is Nobody.’” What name does Journathan give the Cyclops?
lines.narrative: Marginalia removes a disapproving annotation from your sleeve and turns a page. Several corners have been reviewed internally.

lines.native: No exactamente. Journathan es su nombre real, pero da otro nombre al Cíclope. Reading comprehension: still in the footnotes. ¿Qué nombre da en el pasaje? Read carefully; the book is not accepting appeals.
lines.translation: Not exactly. Journathan is his real name, but he gives the Cyclops another name. Reading comprehension: still in the footnotes. What name does he give in the passage? Read carefully; the book is not accepting appeals.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, customers have margins.

lines.native: ¡Correcto! Su nombre es Nadie en el pasaje. Has entendido bien; el libro es tuyo. Reading comprehension: shelf-worthy. My teeth supplied the review, not the spoilers.
lines.translation: Correct! His name is Nobody in the passage. You understood correctly; the book is yours. Reading comprehension: shelf-worthy. My teeth supplied the review, not the spoilers.
lines.narrative: Marginalia slides the book across the counter. One corner is missing; apparently the ending needed trimming.

lines.native: Buenas noches, old friend. ¿Quién está ahí? No spoilers; my eyes are closed.
lines.translation: Good evening, old friend. Who is there? No spoilers; my eyes are closed.
lines.narrative: At the Market Entrance, Marginalia rests with The Journey closed on her finger and her eyes shut, like an old dog guarding a familiar doorstep. The finger is presumably a bookmark, not a review.

lines.native: Te oigo, old friend. Pero en español, por favor. Your English comprehension: impeccable. ¿Quién está ahí?
lines.translation: I hear you, old friend. But in Spanish, please. Your English comprehension: impeccable. Who is there?
lines.narrative: Marginalia keeps her eyes closed and her finger between the pages. The bookmark has tenure.

lines.native: Aquí estás. Muy bien, te oigo. Reading comprehension: approved. I have waited a very long time, among these pages, for someone to read with. Mira, este es mi libro. Aquí pasan muchos años. Las páginas no hablan conmigo.
lines.translation: Here you are. Very good, I hear you. Reading comprehension: approved. I have waited a very long time, among these pages, for someone to read with. Look, this is my book. Many years pass here. The pages do not talk with me.
lines.narrative: Marginalia opens her eyes. She puts a small tick beside your name in the margin, where customers apparently belong.

lines.native: Entiendo, pero eso no es lo que necesito. That describes my situation; it does not deny it. La frase necesita una negación. Reading comprehension: revision required.
lines.translation: I understand, but that is not what I need. That describes my situation; it does not deny it. The sentence needs a negation. Reading comprehension: revision required.
lines.narrative: Marginalia pencils a small correction in the air beside you. Apparently, you have margins.

lines.native: No estoy sola. Tienes razón. Estás aquí, conmigo. Gracias, old friend. Reading comprehension: approved. Puedes leer conmigo. This book is better with company. No spoilers, naturalmente.
lines.translation: I am not alone. You are right. You are here, with me. Thank you, old friend. Reading comprehension: approved. You can read with me. This book is better with company. No spoilers, naturally.
lines.narrative: Marginalia opens her eyes. She makes a small annotation beside your name, then carefully refrains from eating it.
